limitations: Current app includes all 456 satellites of the eight planets in the checked JPL snapshot, including recognized provisional designations. A provisional designation does not mean unconfirmed.
The 461 figure is 456 plus Pluto five; it is not an updated eight-planet total.

All Solar System moons is a broader scope: dwarf planets, asteroids, TNOs and candidate binaries. JPL small-body API is one source snapshot and not guaranteed to incorporate every newest worldwide announcement.
For the combined count use456+499=955, not461+499, because Pluto appears in both JPL lists.
The 38 small-body candidate satellites must remain explicitly unconfirmed, not silently counted as confirmed moons.
